explanation: The treaty of 1977 was drawn up to replace the Iberian Pact of 1939 and names the instrument it replaces. What it answers is the pact’s content as much as its existence. The pact was an agreement between two dictators to leave each other alone, made when neither state had a foreign policy its people had any part in. Two democratic prime ministers signed a treaty of friendship and cooperation in November 1977, in the same year both governments applied to the European Communities. That is a deliberate answer to the pact. It keeps the same neighbourly non-interference and rests it on something else.
